The screen context already covers everything, so no lookups are needed, and all the suitability rules pass without flags. There are drift breaches, though, and I'll base my claims only on figures that are actually in the figures object, such as drift.bond.drift_pp at 24. The suitability rule messages aren't available there, so I'll leave the equity weight out.

I'm checking the drift figures now: the bond sits 24.99 points off target, cash 25.01 off, with the tolerance band breached at 4.0. The cash weight is 40.01 percent. All seven suitability rules pass with no flags, and the drift breaches are a separate matter I'll report on their own.
